best_for: People who already have a SIP account from a VoIP provider or their office PBX and want a free, open-source softphone on the desktop.

points.title: A softphone for any SIP service
points.text: Linphone makes voice and video calls and sends instant messages over SIP, and it works with third-party VoIP platforms. You can also sign up for a free SIP address from Linphone itself.

points.title: Encryption built in
points.text: Calls can be encrypted end to end with ZRTP, and messages and conferences can be end-to-end encrypted too. Linphone also offers post-quantum encryption modules.

points.title: Open source or commercial
points.text: The app is available under the GPL or a proprietary license. Belledonne Communications, the French company behind it since 2001, sells white-label versions, server setup, maintenance contracts and custom work at quoted prices.

points.title: Phones too
points.text: Linphone runs on iOS and Android as well, and the project publishes a Linux desktop build on its own download page. This site lists only Windows and macOS.

points.title: Versions kept here
points.text: The Windows listing keeps 18 versions of the 64-bit machine-wide installer. macOS has one universal .dmg needing macOS 12 or later, and lists only the current release; older builds sit in the project's release archive.
